
DESCRIPTION
Deploy a project

USAGE
  one deploy [project] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one deploy
  one deploy web
  one deploy web --provider vercel --profile work

TIPS
Deploys every configured project, or only the project named by the positional argument. A compatible deployment target and local connection are chosen on first deployment.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Print the deployment plan without applying it
  --env <value>            Deployment and environment-variable environment name
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  --build-version <value>  Image version for non-interactive Kubernetes deployment
  --env-provider <value>   Override the environment-variable source ID
  --profile <value>        Use a named local connection for this run
  -p, --project <value>    Legacy project selector (prefer the positional project)
  --provider <value>       Choose a deployment target explicitly
